hazards: GHS05 Corrosive (Causes severe skin burns and eye damage). GHS07 Irritant (May cause respiratory irritation). May be corrosive to metals.
handling: Handle only inside certified chemical fume hood. Never pour water into acid (exothermic spattering hazard). Always add acid to water (AA).

first_aid.eye_contact: Flush immediately with copious water for 15 minutes holding eyelids open. Seek emergency medical attention.
first_aid.skin_contact: Remove contaminated clothing instantly and wash affected area with deluge shower.

storage: Store in acid-resistant corrosion cabinet away from bases, hypochlorites, and active metals.
